note_rot90: the cell statistic is a per-cell pixel fraction, invariant under rotating the tile with its cell lattice; the rot-90 flagged rate therefore equals the flagged rate over ALL control cells (text and intercolumn), so a detector with high text recall cannot pass it. note_synthetic: synthetic sheets draw voxels i.i.d. from the control's empirical class histograms (interior p99.9 = 255) with no spatial correlation, so the max over 11 slices is inflated and every synthetic cell exceeds the tiny frozen F; the 100 % synthetic flag rate is therefore a weakness of the generator, not evidence about the channel. The verdict FAIL for both faces holds on sensitivity alone (held-out recall 0.074 / 0.033 vs bar 0.90).
